author: cms-sw
body: This change allows to override buildin RPM macros e.g. `builddir` . This is useful as RPM 4.20 sets `builddir` to `/build/path/BUILD/arch/family/name/version/package-name` as in our case package-name is `family+name+version` ( e.g. for root it is `lcg+root+6.40.1-hash`)  and then newer ROOT fails to build due to `+` char in build path. This fix should fallback to our old build path which was `/build/path/BUILD/arch/family/name/version` ( i.e. no extra `family+name+version` )
title: Allow cmsBuild to inject extra macros for prep/build/install sections
